name: Summit AZ - Competitor Tracking 2026-10-09
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-10-09

# Summary
Internal competitor analysis (never name or link these competitors in client content). Sources: Search Atlas rank tracker 84536 (71 keywords, Aug 13 to Oct 9) and public Google Maps listings read in Chrome on Oct 9. An izyLocal grid scan was not run because the account had 0 credits.

# GBP comparison
- Summit Plumbing Pros LLC: 4.8, 523 reviews, Mesa, closes 5 PM.
- EZ Flow Plumbing (Chandler): 4.9, 1,337 reviews, open until 9 PM, weekly posts linking to its site, replies to every review, "Book" button.
- Camcor Plumbing & Water Treatment (Mesa): 4.9, 951 reviews, same hours as Summit, posts every few days naming Mesa, Gilbert and Chandler; the closest head-to-head competitor.
- Los Plumbers Rooter and Plumbing (Mesa): 4.9, 94 reviews but 8 tracked keywords in the top 10; Spanish-language posts with a fixed-price offer.

# Map results from Summit's Mesa location
- Summit did not appear in the first 10 or so results for "plumber mesa az", "drain cleaning mesa" or "water heater repair mesa". The map pack shows a different set (PlumbSmart, Priority One of Mesa, Mesa Plumbing Co, Hansen, Phend and others).
- One search point only; results depend on location and history.

# Takeaways (information only)
1. Two competitor sets: website competitors and map pack competitors; the map pack is Summit's weakest area.
2. Most map pack leaders show "Open 24 hours", which Summit cannot and must not claim.
3. Competitors post weekly and reply to every review (GBP is hands off for TAG).
4. Exact-match business names rank with few reviews.

# Decisions and status
- Next step: Kim to buy izyLocal credits, then run a small grid scan per keyword around the Mesa office.
